objects.description: [Bundlore](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0482) will enumerate the macOS version to determine which follow-on behaviors to execute using /usr/bin/sw_vers -productVersion.(Citation: MacKeeper Bundlore Apr 2019)(Citation: 20 macOS Common Tools and Techniques)
objects.description_fa: [Bundlore](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0482) نسخه macOS را برمی‌شمارد تا مشخص کند کدام رفتارهای بعدی را با استفاده از /usr/bin/sw_vers -productVersion اجرا کند.(Citation: MacKeeper Bundlore Apr 2019)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_2]] (Citation: 20 macOS Common Tools and Techniques)
